arxiv-1910-09118.title: Automated Reasoning with Restricted Intensional Sets
arxiv-1910-09118.creator: MAXIMILIANO CRISTIÁ GIANFRANCO ROSSI
arxiv-1910-09118.description: Abstract Intensional sets, i.e., sets given by a property rather than by enumerating elements, are widely recognized as a key feature to describe complex problems (see, e.g., specification languages such as B and Z). Notwithstanding, very few tools exist supporting high-level automated reasoning on general formulas involving intensional sets.

arxiv-2103-00220.title: Vector dark matter from split SU(2) gauge bosons
arxiv-2103-00220.creator: Zexi Hu, Chengfeng Cai, Yi-Lei Tang, Zhao-Huan Yu, Hong-Hao Zhang
arxiv-2103-00220.description: Abstract We propose a vector dark matter model with an exotic dark SU ⁡ ( 2 ) \mathrm{SU}(2) gauge group. Two Higgs triplets are introduced to spontaneously break the symmetry. All of the dark gauge bosons become massive, and the lightest one is a viable vector DM candidate. Its stability is guaranteed by a remaining Z 2 Z_{2} symmetry.

arxiv-2112-13158.title: Bouncing against the Yellow Void - exploring the outbursts of ρ \rho Cas from visual observations Journal: JAAVSO NumPy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ) .
arxiv-2112-13158.creator: Grigoris Maravelias, Michaela Kraus
arxiv-2112-13158.description: Abstract Massive stars are rare but of paramount importance for their immediate environment and their host galaxies. They lose mass from their birth through strong stellar winds up to their spectacular end of their lives as supernovae. The mass loss changes as they evolve and in some phases it becomes episodic or displays outburst activity.

arxiv-2201-08948.title: How the Universe postpones the evaporation and curtails the quantum spreading of black holes
arxiv-2201-08948.creator: Quinn Taylor, Glenn D. Starkman
arxiv-2201-08948.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Quinn Taylor, Glenn D. Starkman. Black holes are expected to evaporate through the process of Hawking radiation. This process is expected to cause the uncertainty in a black hole’s position to grow to ∼ M 2 / M P ​ l 3 \sim M^{2}/M_{Pl}^{3} over the course of it’s lifetime, even as its momentum spreads only by ∼ M P ​ l \sim M_{Pl} .

arxiv-2210-17007.title: Long time solutions for 1D cubic dispersive equations, Part II: the focusing case
arxiv-2210-17007.creator: Mihaela Ifrim, Daniel Tataru
arxiv-2210-17007.description: Abstract . This article is concerned with one dimensional dispersive flows with cubic nonlinearities on the real line. In a very recent work, the authors have introduced a broad conjecture for such flows, asserting that in the defocusing case, small initial data yields global, scattering solutions. Then this conjecture was proved in the case of a Schrödinger dispersion relation.

arxiv-2211-01881.title: Flows of 3-edge-colorable cubic signed graphs
arxiv-2211-01881.creator: Liangchen Li, Chong Li, Rong Luo, Cun-Quan Zhang, Hailiang Zhang
arxiv-2211-01881.description: Abstract Bouchet conjectured in 1983 that every flow-admissible signed graph admits a nowhere-zero 6-flow which is equivalent to the restriction to cubic signed graphs. In this paper, we proved that every flow-admissible 3 3 -edge-colorable cubic signed graph admits a nowhere-zero 10 10 -flow.

arxiv-2305-18782.title: VVC Extension Scheme for Object Detection Using Contrast Reduction
arxiv-2305-18782.creator: Takahiro Shindo, Taiju Watanabe, Kein Yamada and Hiroshi Watanabe
arxiv-2305-18782.description: Abstract In recent years, video analysis using Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been widely used, due to the remarkable development of image recognition technology using deep learning. In 2019, the Moving Picture Experts Group (MPEG) has started standardization of Video Coding for Machines (VCM) as a video coding technology for image recognition.

arxiv-2308-13614.title: The role of interior dynamics and differentiation on the surface and atmosphere of lava planets
arxiv-2308-13614.creator: Charles-Édouard Boukaré, Daphné Lemasquerier, Nicolas B. Cowan, Henri Samuel, James Badro, Lisa Dang, Aurélien Falco, Sébastien Charnoz
arxiv-2308-13614.description: Abstract Lava planets are rocky exoplanets that orbit so close to their host star that their day-side is hot enough to melt silicate rock. Their short orbital periods ensure that lava planets are tidally locked into synchronous rotation, with permanent day and night hemispheres.

arxiv-2405-15966.title: Quantitative stability of Sobolev inequalities on compact Riemannian manifolds
arxiv-2405-15966.creator: Francesco Nobili, Davide Parise
arxiv-2405-15966.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Francesco Nobili, Davide Parise. We study quantitative stability results for different classes of Sobolev inequalities on general compact Riemannian manifolds. We prove that, up to constants depending on the manifold, a function that nearly saturates a critical Sobolev inequality is quantitatively W 1 , 2 W^{1,2} -close to a non-empty set of extremal functions, provided that the corresponding optimal Sobolev constant satisfies a suitable strict bound. The case of sub-critical Sobolev inequalities is also covered. Finally, we discuss degenerate phenomena in our quantitative controls.

arxiv-2501-09496.title: Cohomology of type B B real permutohedral varieties Thanks: This work was supported by the National Research Foundation of Korea Grant funded by the Korean Government (NRF-2021R1A6A1A10044950).
arxiv-2501-09496.creator: Younghan Yoon
arxiv-2501-09496.description: Abstract . Type A A and type B B permutohedral varieties are classic examples of mathematics, and their topological invariants are well known. This naturally leads to the investigation of the topology of their real loci, known as type A A and type B B real permutohedral varieties.

arxiv-2507-10423.title: On Ulrich Bundles on some decomposable threefold scrolls over 𝔽 a {\mathbb{F}}_{a} Thanks: The second author has been partially supported by the MIUR Excellence Department Project MatMod@TOV, MIUR CUP-E83C23000330006, 2023-2027, awarded to the Department of Mathematics, University of Rome Tor Vergat
arxiv-2507-10423.creator: Maria Lucia Fania, Flaminio Flamini, Francesco Malaspina, Joan Pons-Llopis
arxiv-2507-10423.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maria Lucia Fania, Flaminio Flamini, Francesco Malaspina, Joan Pons-Llopis. This paper investigates Ulrich bundles on decomposable threefold scrolls X X over the Hirzebruch surface 𝔽 a \mathbb{F}_{a} , for any integer a ≥ 0 a\geq 0 , focusing on the study of their structure and classification. We prove existence of such Ulrich bundles, studying their properties, determining conditions for the Ulrich complexity of their support variety X X and analyzing instances of Ulrich wildness for X X .

arxiv-2508-10622.title: Interference between non-overlapping waves
arxiv-2508-10622.creator: Alan C. Santos, Celso J. Villas-Boas
arxiv-2508-10622.description: Abstract In classical mechanics and electromagnetism, interference occurs when two or more waves overlap at the same point in spacetime. However, the advent of quantum electrodynamics (QED) and its remarkable success in describing light–matter interactions at the microscopic level invites us to reconsider whether interference-like effects could arise even when the waves do not physically overlap.

arxiv-2509-13020.title: Łukasiewicz Logic with Actions for Neural Networks training
arxiv-2509-13020.creator: Ioana Leuştean a, Bogdan Macovei a,b
arxiv-2509-13020.description: Abstract Based on the already known connection between multilayer perceptrons and Łukasiewicz logic with rational coefficients, we take a step forward in analyzing its training process using a three-sorted hybrid modal logic: a multilayer perceptron is a logical formula; the actions of the training process are modal operators; the training process is a sequence of logical deductions.

However, understanding the interface and dipole effects based on microscopic and macroscopic perspectives, rather than semi-empirical rules, can facilitate the design of heterointerfaces and defects to adjust the impedance matching and electromagnetic wave absorption of the material, which is currently lacking.

pmc-10738615.title: IDENTIFYING SOLUTIONS TO ADDRESS THE BEHAVIORAL HEALTH OF OLDER ADULTS: A QUALITATIVE ANALYSIS
pmc-10738615.creator: Allyson Stodola, Sheryl Elliott, Nathan Parsons, Sarah Dys, Susan Sotka, Walter Dawson
pmc-10738615.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The Oregon Older Adult Behavioral Health Initiative (OABHI), a program of the Oregon Health Authority, seeks to improve behavioral health (BH) services for older adults and people living with physical disabilities. Twenty-four OABHI Specialists work with BH and Aging services agencies, community-based organizations, and other key partners to strengthen the BH workforce, educate communities, provide complex care consultations, improve intra-agency collaborations, and foster timely access to coordinated, culturally-responsive services.

pmc-11672941.title: Valorization of Selected Biomass-Derived Molecules on Olea europaea Leaves-Biotemplated TiO2-g-C3N4 Photocatalysts
pmc-11672941.creator: M Carmen Herrera-Beurnio, Francisco J López-Tenllado, Alejandro Ariza-Pérez, Jesús Hidalgo-Carrillo, Rafael Estevez, Juan Martín-Gómez, Francisco J Urbano, Alberto Marinas, Yijing Tang
pmc-11672941.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Biotemplating technique allows the synthesis of catalysts, recreating the sophisticated structure of nature templates. In this work, some biotemplated TiO2 semiconductors were synthesized using Olea europaea leaves as templates. Then, g-C3N4 was coupled to materials to later incorporate Pt on the surface or as dopant in the structure to evaluate the efficiency of the solids in two photocatalytic applications to valorize biomass: hydrogen production through glycerol photoreforming, and photoacetalization of cinnamaldehyde with 1,2-propanediol.

pmc-11679755.title: A Comprehensive Review of the Latest Trends in Spray Freeze Drying and Comparative Insights with Conventional Technologies
pmc-11679755.creator: Maria Ioannou Sartzi, Dimitrios Drettas, Marina Stramarkou, Magdalini Krokida
pmc-11679755.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Spray freeze drying (SFD) represents an emerging drying technique designed to produce a wide range of pharmaceuticals, foods, and active components with high quality and enhanced stability due to their unique structural characteristics. This method combines the advantages of the well-established techniques of freeze drying (FD) and spray drying (SD) while overcoming their challenges related to high process temperatures and durations.

pmc-13059410.title: Bridging neurobiological mechanisms and translational applications in cognitive science: inspirations from the MCCS-NYUAD meeting 2025
pmc-13059410.creator: Mohammad Nami, Dan Ohtan Wang, MCCS-NYUAD Panel
pmc-13059410.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The Molecular and Cellular Cognition Society (MCCS) Meeting (NYU Abu Dhabi, February 17-18th, 2025) brought together leading experts in neuroscience to present breakthroughs addressing the molecular and neuronal mechanisms underlying cognition, emotion, and behavior. This review is inspired by the meeting, which emphasized emerging molecular and cellular mechanisms including epigenetic regulation of memory, dynamic engram synapse formation, synaptic epitranscriptomics, metaplasticity, and metabolomic-neuroimmune interactions.

pmc-13206153.title: Academic Well-Being Among STEM University Students Living Away from Home: A Mixed-Methods Study
pmc-13206153.creator: Barbara Loera, Federica Graziano, Giorgia Molinengo, Daniela Converso, Giulia Bacci

pmc-13535437.creator: Humberto Itriago, Marita Cohn
pmc-13535437.description: Telomerase is a specialized ribonucleoprotein enzyme responsible for elongation of telomeres, the DNA ends of eukaryotic chromosomes. uslaw-usc-t28-s1501.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part IV (Jurisdiction And Venue); Chapter 91 (United States Court Of Federal Claims).
